name: 98404 · Tacoma, WA
findings: ZIP 98404 (Tacoma) has 82 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98404 (Tacoma) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
